title: A larger distant object
hook: Change physical diameter and predict small angular diameter.
misconception: small angular diameter stays fixed when physical diameter doubles.
objective: Apply angle ≈ diameter/distance to compare small angular diameter when physical diameter changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With fixed distance much larger than the diameter, angle ≈ diameter/distance. When physical diameter doubles, small angular diameter becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model angle ≈ diameter/distance; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider fixed distance much larger than the diameter, with a nonzero initial result. If physical diameter triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on small angular diameter?
recall.why: Apply angle ≈ diameter/distance under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
